verdict.rationale: Viam says inline logic modules (its automation vehicle) have source code, builds, versioning and deployment managed by the platform. Its marketing advertises canary testing, rollbacks for safe versioning, and OTA software updates, and it describes versioning, staging and rolling back ML models 'just like code'. Nothing in the evidence covers a review step for automation changes, and module rollback appears only as a homepage claim. Missing for 10: any review/diff/approval workflow for automation changes, detailed docs on how module versions are rolled back, independent or hands-on corroboration.
